description: This file defines the LandedCostVoucher class for handling landed cost vouchers in ERPNext, including methods for retrieving items from purchase receipts, validation, calculation of taxes and charges, and updating stock and asset information.

classes.name: LandedCostVoucher
classes.description: A class representing a Landed Cost Voucher document, with methods for managing landed costs, including item retrieval, validation, and stock/asset updates.

methods.name: get_items_from_purchase_receipts
methods.description: Retrieves items from associated purchase receipts and adds them to the LandedCostVoucher.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation checks on the document, including mandatory fields, receipt documents, and applicable charges.

methods.name: check_mandatory
methods.description: Checks if purchase receipts are entered.

methods.name: validate_receipt_documents
methods.description: Validates the status and correctness of purchase receipt documents.

methods.name: set_applicable_charges_on_item
methods.description: Distributes total taxes and charges across items based on configuration.

methods.name: validate_applicable_charges_for_item
methods.description: Validates that total applicable charges match total taxes and charges.

methods.name: on_submit
methods.description: Triggers update of landed costs upon submission.

methods.name: on_cancel
methods.description: Triggers update of landed costs upon cancellation.

methods.name: update_landed_cost
methods.description: Updates stock, assets, and valuation rates related to the landed cost.

methods.name: validate_asset_qty_and_status
methods.description: Checks if assets linked to purchase receipts are correctly created and not submitted.

methods.name: update_rate_in_serial_no_for_non_asset_items
methods.description: Updates purchase rates in serial number records for non-asset items.
